notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Gimmick's Gadgets
Version 1.0.2 Changes
- Loading will be a little slower, but the tips are easier to read now.
- Added an initial first draft tutorial when you load the game the first time.
- Elec Tunnels have had their focus price reduced.
- Magnifiers now emit particles when goggles are on.
- Optimizers now emit particles when goggles are on.
- Fixed a graphical bug when going to the credits screen on high resolutions.

notes.title: Gimmick's Gadgets Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Gimmick's Gadgets
Version 1.0.1 Changes

 - The Space Mouse splash screen should now respect volume options.
 - Sped up movement of chatboxes.
 - Darkening the background when a chatbox is visible.
 - Added resolution changing in the options, or with the shortcut key "R".

- Resolution now can go on a 0.5x-2.0x scale.
- Note that changing resolution disables some advanced graphical effects.
- Changing Resolution will be remembered in your save file.
